content:
lee: Heads-up: customer reports ~30 token overcharges on long-running chat when a toolcall was truncated and we retried on a different router. Attached sample trace.

lee: trace snippet:
```
client.conn: session=xyz-77 seq=102..117
router-A: forwarded seq 102..110 to model shard-3
model: emitted toolcall(tc-7) truncated at seq 110 final=false
router-A: lost connection
router-B: resume session=xyz-77 last_seen=109 replay seq 110..117 -> emits provisional +30 credits
billing: ledger wrote provisional row for tc-7 seq 110..117
recon: later confirms original tc-7 final, also confirms seq 110..117 -> duplicate confirmed credits
```

nina: Is the duplication happening because router-B doesn't know router-A already sent a provisional row? Do we have any cross-router small-AOOS (at-most-once semantics) for provisional writes?

cass: Short answer: no. Provisional writes are cheap writes to the ledger keyed by (session, seq-range, toolcall_id) but we don't atomically dedupe across routers today. We rely on reconciliation to clear dupes, which can be minutes-late.

lee: Customer hit shows small but material billing noise; they exported daily CSV and flagged it. Our Console aggregates hide provisional rows so support couldn't see why the CSV had the spike.

nina: Proposal A (cheap): add a lightweight tombstone check on ingress when resuming. Router includes resumepoint {session, last_seq, last_toolcall_id}; ingress checks recent provisional entries for overlapping ranges within a 30s window and squashes duplicate provisional writes. Adds a tiny conditional write per resume.

cass: Risks: race if original provisional write hasn't propagated yet; conditional could drop a legitimate fresh write and under-report until final confirm. Also increases ingress write QPS slightly.

nina: Proposal B (visibility-first): surface provisional ledger rows in Console "Billing -> Recent activity" behind a toggle + show reconciled vs open provisional counts and link to raw ledger rows. That helps reduce support escalations while we iterate.

lee: I prefer A + B: reduce occurrence and make it explorable. Also propose small reconciliation sprint to prioritize deduping confirmed duplicates in billing pipeline (annul duplicates before CSV export).

cass: Implementation plan for A: router will attach resume_meta {router_id, last_seq, last_toolcall_id} and an ingress pre-check endpoint will attempt an idempotent upsert:
```
POST /ledger/provisional/upsert
body: {session, start_seq, end_seq, toolcall_id, origin_router}
headers: X-Request-Id
```
If overlap detected return 409 and router will skip provisional write (but still forward stream).

nina: For UX: Console change should include a small banner on billing page: "Provisional charges may appear in CSVs; enable 'show provisional' to see intermediate rows." Also an ops dashboard panel with provisional->confirmed delta trend and a per-tenant drill to see offending sessions.

lee: OK. Quick telemetry ask: create a meter for "provisional_upsert_conflicts" and a histogram for overlap_size_tokens. We need to quantify how often there's overlap > 0.

cass: I'll add metrics: provisional_upsert_attempts, provisional_upsert_conflicts, provisional_confirmed_duplicates. Also tag with origin_router and tenant_id.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for ingress patch at 1791238000 (patch: ingress-provisional-guard-0.1)

nina: Rollout plan: enable conditional upsert behind FF "ingress.provisional_guard" for 2% traffic for 24h, watch provisional_upsert_conflicts and confirmed_duplicates. If conflicts high with low duplicates -> fine. If verified under-reporting -> rollback.

lee: Customer remediation: billing-team should run a one-off dedupe for that tenant and reconcile their CSV. Who owns the ticket? @billing-bot?

billing-bot: Assigned BILL-773 to @cass for immediate dedupe job. ETA 48h.

cass: Action items:
- PR: ingress pre-upsert + 409 semantics (cass) - open today
- Metrics + dashboard panel (nina) - prototype EOD
- Console toggle + tooltip copy (lee) - mock by tomorrow
- Billing dedupe run for affected tenant (cass) - runbook + ticket

nina: UX copy suggestion: "Provisional rows are temporary records created during streaming/resume. They help keep the stream live but may be de-duped during reconciliation." Short, helpful.

lee: Thanks. We'll sync post-canary and aim to enable 2% -> 10% -> 100% if no regression in 72h.

cass: Note: also check token-attribution when toolcall spans a model-swap; we might attribute the tail to a different model variant which complicates dedupe keys. We'll include model-version in the upsert key if present.

nina: Great catch. Add model_version tag to metrics as well.

lee: Closing: create RFC for long-term approach: move provisional writes behind an optimistic confirm-from-model (i.e., defer provisional until model signals final for toolcalls > N tokens). That reduces speculative credits at expense of slightly higher latency for certain tool calls. RFC owner: lee.

deploy-bot: canary started at 1791238000, status: in_progress

lee: thanks all. If anyone sees a spike in provisional_upsert_conflicts after canary, ping #eng-oncall and I'll pause rollout.
